name: 39783-longprefill-70b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1 -- one node, four GPUs; 141 GB of bf16 weights needs at least three cards in any case.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1; bounded at 110 requests with a 10% warmup trim, leaving about 99 measured. One stream rather than an open-loop arrival rate.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed lengths -- a 5,000-token prompt and an 8-token generation, no shared prefix, prefix caching off.
purpose: A document analysis assistant on a 70B model, handling single 5,000-token documents one at a time across four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine command line. Box: 4 GPUs of one 8x H100 80GB HBM3 a3 node.

model: unsloth/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 8192

# PINNED, not tuned: 8192 / 1024 are what a real `vllm serve` picks on a >=70 GiB non-A100 card.
# An in-process engine build falls through to 2048 / 128 instead and reshapes every forward pass.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
